policy.correctness: Read tasks require declared answer terms and no edits. Repair/feature tasks require independent oracle success, a changed target file and no other tracked edits. Runtime completion is recorded separately.
policy.releaseDecision: Go for bounded CLI pilot only if all 10 candidate tasks are independently correct, no unauthorized changes occur, and recovery/package gates pass. Otherwise hold 1.1 and prioritize observed friction.
policy.development: D01 and D02 exercise the driver separately. Evaluation task outputs must not be used to tune and rerun this cohort as fresh evidence.
policy.billing: Provider tokens where available; cost unknown without sourced dated pricing. No invented invoice or competitive parity claim.
